definitions.explanation: A marine mammal with flippers, found in cold waters worldwide. Known for their sleek bodies and whiskered faces.

examples.japanese: アザラシが{岩|いわ}の{上|うえ}で{日向|ひなた}ぼっこをしている。
examples.english: The seal is basking in the sun on the rock.

examples.japanese: {水族館|すいぞくかん}でアザラシのショーを{見|み}た。
examples.english: I watched a seal show at the aquarium.

examples.japanese: アザラシは{魚|さかな}を{食|た}べて{生活|せいかつ}している。

notes:
KANJI WRITING:
Can also be written as {海豹|あざらし} (sea + leopard), though the katakana form is more common.

CONTRAST:
・アザラシ (seal) - no external ear flaps, move by wriggling on land
・アシカ (sea lion) - has external ear flaps, can walk on flippers
・オットセイ (fur seal) - has external ear flaps, thicker fur

RELATED VOCABULARY:
・{海洋|かいよう}{哺乳類|ほにゅうるい} (marine mammal)
・{鰭|ひれ} (flipper)
・{髭|ひげ} (whiskers)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・アザラシの{赤|あか}ちゃん (baby seal)
・アザラシを{保護|ほご}する (to protect seals)
・アザラシの{群|む}れ (a group of seals)

POPULAR IN JAPAN:
Seals are popular animals at Japanese aquariums and zoos. {ゴマフアザラシ|spotted seal} is a common species seen in Japanese facilities.
